unit_title: account.journal — journal type architecture, sequence, lock, bank/cash controls
key_finding: Odoo 19 Community adds a distinct 'credit' journal type for credit cards (code prefix CCD); account_control_ids was removed from account.journal core — field exists only as a test-dynamically-created custom field (x_account_control_ids); hash chain (restrict_mode_hash_table) uses SHA-256 chaining stored in inalterable_hash and cannot be disabled once hashed entries exist.

HIGH: account_control_ids removed from Community core — custom module required for journal-level account restriction
restrict_mode_hash_table cannot be disabled once hashed entries exist — carry hash state carefully
company_id is immutable once entries exist — multi-company journal provisioning must be done pre-go-live
MEDIUM: New 'credit' type requires re-typing existing credit-card bank journals
refund_sequence state must be preserved during journal migration
suspense_account_id must be of type asset_current in CoA
Alias domain required for mail-to-invoice feature on sale/purchase journals
Hash version upgraded to v4 — integrity report must handle multi-version chains
LOW: Code auto-generation logic unchanged for sale/purchase/cash/bank/general
profit_account_id / loss_account_id auto-filled from company defaults
